text: Our system loads baseline examples from a JSON file to compute the centroid vector of clean responses.
We measure the cosine distance between the centroid vector and any incoming prompt response to monitor for semantic drift.
An auto-calibrated threshold is determined using the 95th percentile of distances within the baseline examples to minimise false positives.
The drift detector operates within a low-overhead decorator, reporting metrics and latency to a JSON Lines log file.
If consecutive evaluations show a distance metric exceeding our threshold, a warning is raised to flag potential context degradation.
